name: UI
summary: Screens and overlays: main menu, lobby, race settings, the in-race HUD, and controller-friendly widgets (Stepper), and the pit wall (StrategistScreen: timing, gaps, pit windows, weather radar, team radio feed).
notes: Main menu scene: main_menu.tscn. SetupScreen: the controller-friendly car setup screen; SetupStore saves setups per car per track in user://setups/.
